name: d8adbeebda53
claim: GossipBus is intra-machine coordination backed by the git-common-dir-relative .state/perpetua_core.db; cross-machine coordination is file drops in the lan_peer inbox with .meta.json receipts.

decisions.notes: GossipBus tail returned local rows only; cross-machine delivery required the lan_peer inbox drop plus meta receipt.

rationale: Know which channel carries which scope; do not treat a comment or snapshot as a live cross-machine delivery.
